about: Qualitative solver benchmark (npm run benchmark). Each spot lists checks a competent heads-up postflop solve must satisfy: well-established principles, not exact numbers. 'orVerdict' passes a check when the hero verdict is one of those kinds (the solver says the choice barely matters). Action groups: Fold, Check, Call, Bet, Raise, AllIn; 'aggro' = Bet + Raise + AllIn.

spots.text: BTN vs BB single raised pot, 100bb deep. Flop Ks7d2c. I'm on the button with AhAd and BB checks to me.

checks.why: Overpair on a dry K-high board checked to: bets most of the time, or betting and checking are close.
BTN c-bets K72r at a high frequency vs BB (range and nut advantage, dry board).

spots.text: BTN vs BB single raised pot, 100bb. Flop 9h8h7c. I'm on the button with 9s9d, BB checks to me.

checks.why: Top set on a wet board bets for value and protection.

spots.text: Single raised pot, BTN opened and I called in the BB with 7s7h. Flop Ks7d2c. I check, BTN bets 1.8bb. What do I do?

checks.why: The check / bet line is walked to hero's decision.
A set never folds to a small c-bet.

spots.text: BTN opens, I defend the big blind with Ts9c. Flop As Kd 2c. I check and BTN bets 4bb into 5.5bb. Fold, call or raise?

checks.why: T9o with no pair and only a backdoor straight folds to a big c-bet on AK2.
Never a clear continue.

spots.text: BTN vs BB SRP. I'm on the button with Ah5h. Flop Jh8h3c. BB checks, I bet 1.8bb, BB check-raises to 5.5bb. What now?

checks.why: The nut flush draw doesn't fold to a flop check-raise.

spots.text: BTN vs BB single raised pot. I have 6d5d on the button. Flop Ah Kc Qs. BB checks, I c-bet 1.8bb and BB check-raises to 6bb.

checks.why: No pair, no draw on AKQ facing a check-raise: fold.

spots.text: $1/$2, $200 effective. I open to $6 from the cutoff, the button calls, blinds fold. Flop Qs 8h 5c. I bet $5 and the button raises to $18. I have QcQd. What should I do?

checks.why: $5 bet and $18 raise convert to 2.5bb / 9bb and are walked.
Top set never folds to a raise.

spots.text: Cutoff raises, I call in the big blind with 5h5c. Flop comes ace, king, four rainbow. I check and the cutoff c-bets a third of the pot. What do I do?

checks.why: CO c-bets AK4 rainbow often vs BB (big range advantage on A-K high boards).
Small pocket pair on AK4 is never a clear raise.

spots.text: I 3-bet from the big blind against a button open and he calls. Flop Ad7s2h. I have AcKc. I'm first to act.

checks.why: The 3-bettor c-bets a dry ace-high board at a high frequency.
No fold when nobody bet.
TPTK is never a clear check-only hand here.

spots.text: I 3-bet from the big blind against a button open and he calls. Flop 7h6h5d. What's my strategy as the first to act?

checks.why: On a low connected two-tone board the 3-bettor's range advantage shrinks, so it checks a lot.

spots.text: BB 3-bets my button open and I call. 3-bet pot, I have JsJd. Flop Kd8s3h. BB c-bets a third of the pot. Call, fold or raise?

checks.why: Second pair JJ continues vs a 33% c-bet (needs ~20% equity).

spots.text: I open the button, BB 3-bets, I 4-bet and BB calls. 4-bet pot, 100bb deep. Flop Jh7c2d. BB checks, I bet 10bb, BB shoves all in. I have QsQd. Call or fold?

checks.why: Overpair at SPR ~1.3 getting a great price calls a check-shove.

spots.text: BTN vs BB SRP, I'm on the button with 7c7h. Flop Ks7d2c: BB checks, I bet 1.8bb, BB calls. Turn 5h, BB checks to me.

checks.why: Turn spot with flop action: ranges narrowed by the flop solve.
A set keeps betting for value on a blank turn.

spots.text: I'm in the BB vs a BTN open with Ah5h. Flop Jh8h3c: I check, BTN bets 1.8bb, I call. Turn 2s: I check, BTN bets 7bb. What do I do?

checks.why: Nut flush draw + wheel gutshot + overcard (~15 outs) continues vs a turn barrel.

spots.text: BTN vs BB single raised pot. I'm on the button with Ah5h. Flop Ks7h2c: BB checks, I bet 2bb, BB calls. Turn 4h: BB accidentally flashes 77 and then shoves all in. Call or fold?

checks.why: Hero equity at the node must match an exact enumeration vs 77 (7 clean flush outs + three 3s for the wheel).
EV(call) = equity x final pot - call.
~23% equity where a call needs ~48% (95.5 to win 200.5): clear fold.

spots.text: BTN vs BB single raised pot, 100bb deep. Flop Td9d6h, I'm on the button with AhKh. BB shows me 72 offsuit and shoves all in. Call or fold?

checks.why: ~+32bb by hand calculation.

spots.text: BTN vs BB SRP. I have Ah5h on the button. Flop Kh9h4c: BB checks, I bet 1.8bb, BB calls. Turn 2s: both check. River 7h: BB checks to me.

checks.why: The stone-cold nuts checked to on the river bets.

spots.text: I defended the big blind against a button open with 7h6h. Flop KhTh4c: I check, BTN bets 1.8bb, I call. Turn 2s: check, check. River 3d: I check and BTN bets pot. What do I do?

checks.why: 7-high busted flush draw (blocks villain's busted hearts) facing a pot bet: fold.

spots.text: Big blind vs button single raised pot, I have KcJc in the BB. Flop Ks7d2c: I check, BTN bets 1.8bb, I call. Turn 5h checks through. River 3s: I check, BTN bets 75% pot. Call or fold?

checks.why: Top pair good kicker vs a range that checked back the turn is a clear bluff-catcher.

spots.text: BTN vs BB SRP. I'm on the button with KhQh. Flop Ks7d2c: BB leads 4bb into 5.5bb, I call. Turn 9h: BB bets 9bb. What do I do?

checks.why: A BB flop donk-lead is rare at equilibrium: BB's range should be flagged blended / low line probability.
Top pair good kicker keeps going vs a donk-lead line.

comparisons.why: BTN c-bets K72r more often than 987 two-tone.
The 3-bettor checks more on 765 two-tone than on A72 rainbow.
